verses.1: Who is this man who comes from Adam, wearing clothes made of fine materials? He’s in a state of great vigor and strength. I speak with great justice, so that he may be saved.
verses.2: Why does man wear your clothes and adorn your body as if it were a path to be walked on?
verses.3: I have walked alone, without any company. There is no one with me. I walk among them, and I burn them with my fire. May they be destroyed on my altar, and all their offerings will be destroyed as well.
verses.4: For the day of retribution has come in my heart, and my years of suffering will end.
verses.5: And there is no help for me; there is no one to save me. My seed will be destroyed, and my lover will abandon me. She is the one who will destroy me.
verses.6: And I will scatter the nations in my anger, and I will destroy them with my fire. They will be scattered over the earth forever.
verses.7: The mercies of Jehovah will be remembered as a blessing for all those who have been blessed by Jehovah. It is a great blessing for the house of Israel, who have received such blessings through His grace and kindness.
verses.8: And he said, “My people, these are good children; they will not deceive others. They will be a source of salvation for us.”
verses.9: In all their troubles, they have no one to help them. But through his love and compassion, he saves them. He carries them along with him, forever.
verses.10: And they caused sorrow and distress to His holy spirit. He became their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.11: And Moses remembered the days of old, his people. Who is like him? Who can compare to him? He raised up the tabernacle from the sea. Who can compare to him in his holy spirit?
verses.12: May Moses’ right hand be blessed, so that it can draw water from their faces, and thus create a place of eternal life for him.
verses.13: They were carried into the wilderness like sheep in a pen; they could not be rescued.
verses.14: Like cattle in the wilderness, so will the Spirit of Jehovah descend upon us. This is how your people have always acted towards you, to show you their respect and honor.
verses.15: Look from heaven, and see the holiness and glory of your name. Oh, your jealousy and pride! They are nothing compared to your greatness and mercy. I am worthy of your compassion.
verses.16: For you are our Father; Abraham did not know us, and Israel did not recognize us. But you, O LORD, our Father, save us from this world.
verses.17: Why do You abandon us, O LORD? Why make it difficult for us to follow Your ways? May You again show us Your kindness, so that our servants may serve in Your land.
verses.18: May your people, who are your holy ones, inherit your holiness. May they be established in your holiness.
verses.19: We were in a world where you did not rule over them. Your name was not called upon among them. You did not tear the heavens apart; you came down from your throne. The mountains trembled.
